reasons: The file contains only a description, so there is nothing to test or judge.

terms.meaning: a folder of Python files that can be imported together

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Package description
sections.what: Gives the utils folder a one-line description. It does not run any code.
sections.why: Python needs a file like this to treat the folder as a package.

summary: Marks the utils folder as a Python package and describes it; it runs no code.
purpose: Gives the shared helpers folder a name and description.
why: Python needs a file like this to treat the folder as a package that other files can import from.
how: Python reads the file when another file imports from this folder.
debug: If imports from utils fail, check that this file exists in the folder.
